description: This file declares the AdbWinUsbIOCompletion class which encapsulates a wrapper around the OVERLAPPED structure used in asynchronous I/O requests via the WinUsb API. It is part of the Android Open Source Project and handles completion of WinUsb I/O operations, including result retrieval and resource management.

classes.name: AdbWinUsbIOCompletion
classes.description: Encapsulates a wrapper around OVERLAPPED Win32 structure for asynchronous I/O completion with WinUsb API.

methods.name: AdbWinUsbIOCompletion
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the I/O completion object with parent I/O object, expected transfer size, and optional event handle.

methods.name: ~AdbWinUsbIOCompletion
methods.description: Destructor, protected to prevent stack allocation.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Overrides the base class method to release resources, ensuring deletion occurs in the module's heap.

methods.name: GetOvelappedIoResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the overlapped I/O operation using WinUsb_GetOverlappedResult.
